state.paragraph: On August 12, 2013, representatives of CSC and Pamplona attended a management presentation at the Boston office of Goodwin Procter with members of Mac-Gray management, representatives of BofA Merrill Lynch and the two members of the Transaction Committee.

ledger_rows.Note: Inferred. 20 signers − Party A (no NDA until 08/05) − 3 submitters = 16. On 07/25 the target named only four interested bidders. Some may have signed after 07/23.

Committee finds IOIs lower than expected. Advances four: Party A (subject to NDA), Party B, Party C, CSC/Pamplona. Staged disclosure; management meetings for all, synergy information for strategics; revised IOIs to follow.
Written IOI after the 07/25 meeting; revises #22 (oral $15.00-$17.00). Answers the round-1 request. Based on the informational package only (Heavy by context).
Talks resumed 07/27 and non-solicit terms agreed. Received the informational package so it could improve its 06/21 proposal (#7).

Information access differs by bidder type: B and C (financial) get broad data-room access; A and CSC/Pamplona (strategic) get limited access, customer data withheld, plus synergy talks. All four had management presentations 08/06-08/14.
Letter to all four (authorized 08/15): revised written proposals due 09/09/2013 to go on to in-depth evaluation. Proposals to cover valuation, financing, approvals, covenants and diligence.
Due date for revised written proposals. CSC/Pamplona and Party B bid on time; Party A and Party C bid on 09/10 and were reviewed on 09/11 (late bids accepted).

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
